convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'ColorZeroLAG_MA' custom indicator with non-standard smoothing methods (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) defined in external SmoothAlgorithms.mqh library. Also depends on TradeAlgorithms.mqh for position management and money management logic.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars needed for indicator warmup
TimeShiftSec - bar duration in seconds
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Signal-based close: buy position closed when indicator turns bearish (Value[1]>Value[2]) and BuyPosClose=true; sell position closed when indicator turns bullish (Value[1]<Value[2]) and SellPosClose=true

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum controls sizing: LOT=fixed lot size (0.1), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus loss, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus loss. MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or fraction depending on MMMode selection.

custom_logic_notes: The EA reads 3 consecutive values from the ColorZeroLAG_MA indicator buffer at SignalBar offset. Signal logic: if Value[1]<Value[2] (indicator was declining) AND Value[0]>Value[1] (now rising), a bullish crossover is detected -> buy signal. If Value[1]>Value[2] (indicator was rising) AND Value[0]<Value[1] (now declining), a bearish crossover is detected -> sell signal. SignalBar=1 means signals are evaluated on the previous completed bar (not current). The Recount flag forces re-evaluation if CopyBuffer fails. BuyPosOpen/SellPosOpen/BuyPosClose/SellPosClose are boolean inputs that gate whether each trade action is allowed. TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory helper functions.
python_conversion_notes: Two external .mqh libraries must be reimplemented or bypassed: (1) SmoothAlgorithms.mqh provides 10+ custom smoothing algorithms (JJMA, JurX, ParMA, T3, VIDYA, AMA) beyond standard SMA/EMA/SMMA/LWMA - the ColorZeroLAG_MA indicator must be ported first since it is loaded via iCustom. (2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides BuyPositionOpen/SellPositionOpen/BuyPositionClose/SellPositionClose wrappers with MarginMode-based lot calculation - this must be reimplemented. The position sizing logic is conditional on MMMode enum with 5 modes. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - no 5-digit adjustment is done in the EA itself, so raw values (1000/2000) should be used as point distances. Signal logic is straightforward: 3-bar crossover of a single indicator buffer evaluated at SignalBar offset. New bar guard via CIsNewBar class from SmoothAlgorithms.mqh must also be reimplemented.
